title: Selangor had the largest 2024 mean income–expenditure gap: RM6,030 per month (RM13,296 minus RM7,266).
subtitle: Mean gross monthly income minus mean monthly consumption expenditure; current-year RM; 2022 and 2024
notes: Mean-to-mean comparison only; no median household surplus is calculated.
This aggregate gap is not household savings or disposable income; income is gross and expenditure is consumption.
Expenditure levels reflect household size, composition, preferences and resources, not just prices.
headline: Selangor had the largest 2024 mean income–expenditure gap: RM6,030 per month (RM13,296 minus RM7,266). This is a mean-to-mean aggregate comparison, not savings or the median household's budget.
